title: Clo User Story – Calida
description:
Learn how CALIDA, a Swiss company specializing in underwear, nightwear, and loungewear, utilizes CLO 3D software.

"Before we implemented CLO, I always had to wait for the sewing sample to see if my pattern was good and that I put the right lines. And now, I can do the pattern, bring that into CLO, and have a look on the avatar if everything is right and good, and in the right place. So, I can save samples and time and yeah, that's great."

transcript: Calida for me is high quality, super comfy and well-fitting underwear, nightwear and loungewear. So I'm Fabienne Meurie and I'm leading the technical product development team at Calida. These are the pattern makers and the 3D developer. So it was in the beginning of 2021. We set up workarounds and workflows into our company using 3D in different departments. So we do hollows, we do packaging, the visual merchandising guidelines and so on. Before we implemented CLO, I always had to wait for the sewn samples to see if my pattern is good and that I put the right lines and all that. And now I can do the pattern, bring that into CLO and have a look on the avatar if everything is right and good and in the right place. So I can save samples and time and yeah, that's great. The integration of CLO3D resulted in closer or even new collaborations between different departments like the technical product development with the design team or with the visual merchandising, which we didn't have before. So another benefit with Chlo is that for me, for developing the kids collection, I can easily place the motif prints and check the size or the rise placement at the right position so it's really more obvious for everyone, also in the design process and also for the sales team. The benefits we have seen implementing Chlo in relation to visual merchandising that we were faster than before because combinations or changes could be done really fast in 3D so we also could save money or the effort to order something that we might not use for the window. We are going on building up libraries. And bring them to perfection and we will also go on that we have our whole collection in 3D. So I really believe in that 3D is and will be the future of garment manufacturing. We are really happy and we thank Chlo for that great support.
